title: Register the accepted switch_pt executor in the v2 vocabulary

evidence.fact: The accepted parent overlay supplies the switch_pt dispatcher and Layer-7e executor; this child only makes that existing behavior reachable to the parser.
Parser reachability is closed over the cards registry, making the missing registry entry the entire residual bridge.
Primitive has only Executor and ShapeTest fields and must be added through regEffect in a separate init file.
Exact ExecuteAbilityEffect signature, switch_pt dispatch, and existing executor implementation. It is read-only parent behavior for this child.
ResolveTopOfStack invokes ExecuteEffectSequence with the resolving spell's targets; no new spell resolver is required.
Complete local pattern for a spell EffectAtom sequence with a bare creature target and an observable shared-executor result.
Existing v2 spell EffectAtom conversion; do not edit it.

required_behavior: Add exactly one switch_pt v2 Primitive in backend/cards/registry_switch_pt.go using the shown init/regEffect convention.
Set Executor to the existing game/ability_effects.go switch_pt dispatcher and ShapeTest to TestShape_SwitchPT.
Add one focused shape test that asserts registration and casts a spell EffectAtom sequence at one bare creature target, then proves the existing shared executor switched that creature's P/T.
Do not edit parser, converter, the frozen registry literal, or backend/game. Do not add another primitive.
gates: git status --porcelain adds or changes only backend/cards/registry_switch_pt.go and backend/cards/shape_switch_pt_test.go

execution.selection_reason: The no-tools packet contains every exact interface requested by the two bounded NEED responses. Claude cannot commit, push, deploy, or mutate live tickets.

on_failure: Record an immutable receipt. A request to change parser, converter, or Layer-7e execution is a separate TicketSpec.
